Haa Meem
Raushan kitaab ki qasam
Hum ne is Quran ko ek mubaarak raat mein naazil kiya hai, hum beshak azaab se daraane waale the
Is raat mein tamaam hikmat o maslehat ke umoor ka faisla kiya jaata hai
Yeh hamaari taraf ka hukm hota hai, aur hum hi rasoolon ke bhejne waale hain
Yeh aap ke Parwardigar ki rehmat hai, aur yaqeenan woh bahut sunne waala aur jaanne waala hai
Woh aasmaan o zameen aur us ke maa-bain ka Parwardigar hai agar tum yaqeen karne waale ho
Us ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai. Wahi hayaat ata karne waala hai aur wahi maut dene waala hai. Wahi tumhaara bhi Parwardigar hai aur tumhaare guzashta buzurgon ka bhi Parwardigar hai
Lekin yeh log shak ke aalam mein khel tamaasha kar rahe hain
Lihaaza aap us din ka intezaar kijiye jab aasmaan waazeh qism ka dhuaan le kar aa jaaega
Jo tamaam logon ko dhaank lega ke yahi dardnaak azaab hai
Tab sab kahenge ke Parwardigar! Is azaab ko hum se door kar de, hum imaan le aane waale hain
Bhala un ki qismat mein naseehat kahaan, jab ke un ke paas waazeh paighaam waala rasool bhi aa chuka hai
Aur unhon ne us se munh pher liya aur kaha ke yeh sikhaaya padhaaya hua deewaana hai
Khair, hum thodi der ke liye azaab ko hata lete hain, lekin tum phir wahi karne waale ho jo kar rahe ho
Ek din aaega jab hum sakht qism ki giraft karenge, ke hum yaqeenan badla lene waale bhi hain
Aur hum ne un se pehle Fir'aun ki qaum ko aazmaaya jab un ke paas ek mohtaram paighambar aaya
Ke Allah ke bandon ko mere hawaale kar do, main tumhaare liye ek amaanat-daar paighambar hoon
Aur Khuda ke saamne oonche na bano, main tumhaare paas bahut waazeh daleel le kar aaya hoon
Aur main apne aur tumhaare Rab ki panaah chaahta hoon is se ke tum mujhe sangsaar kar do
Aur agar tum imaan nahin laate ho to mujh se alag ho jaao
Phir unhon ne apne Rab se dua ki ke yeh qaum badi mujrim qaum hai
To hum ne kaha ke hamaare bandon ko le kar raaton raat chale jaao ke tumhaara peechha kiya jaane waala hai
Aur darya ko apne haal par saakin chhod kar nikal jaao ke yeh lashkar gharq kiya jaane waala hai
Yeh log kitne hi baaghaat aur chashme chhod gaye
Aur kitni hi khaitiyaan aur umda makaanaat chhod gaye
Aur woh ne'matein jin mein maze uda rahe the
Yahi anjaam hota hai, aur hum ne sab ka waaris doosri qaum ko bana diya
Phir to un par na aasmaan roya aur na zameen, aur na inhein mohlat hi di gayi
Aur hum ne Bani Israaeel ko ruswa-kun azaab se bacha liya
Fir'aun ke shar se, jo zyaadati karne waalon mein bhi sab se ooncha tha
Aur hum ne Bani Israaeel ko tamaam aalameen mein samajh boojh kar intikhaab kiya hai
Aur inhein aisi nishaaniyaan di hain jin mein khula hua imtehaan paaya jaata hai
Beshak yeh log yahi kehte hain
Ke yeh sirf pehli maut hai aur bas, us ke baad hum uthaaye jaane waale nahin hain
Aur agar tum sachche ho to hamaare baap daada ko qabron se utha kar le aao
Bhala yeh log zyaada behtar hain ya qaum-e-Tubba' aur un se pehle waale afraad jinhein hum ne is liye tabaah kar diya ke yeh sab mujrim the
Aur hum ne zameen o aasmaan aur us ki darmiyaani makhlooqaat ko khel tamaasha karne ke liye nahin paida kiya hai
Hum ne inhein sirf haq ke saath paida kiya hai, lekin un ki aksariyat is amr se bhi jaahil hai
Beshak faisle ka din un sab ke uthaaye jaane ka muqarrara waqt hai
Jis din koi dost doosre dost ke kaam aane waala nahin hai aur na un ki koi madad ki jaaegi
Ilaawa us ke jis par Khuda rahm kare, ke beshak woh bada bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai
Beshak aakhirat mein ek thohar ka darakht hai
Jo gunahgaaron ki ghiza hai
Woh pighle hue taanbe ki maanind pet mein josh khaaega
Jaise garm paani josh khaata hai
Farishton ko hukm hoga ke use pakdo aur beechon beech Jahannam tak le jaao
Phir us ke sar par kholte hue paani ka azaab undel do
Kaho ke ab apne kiye ka maza chakho, ke tum to bade saahib-e-izzat aur mohtaram kahe jaate the
Yahi woh azaab hai jis mein tum shak paida kar rahe the
Beshak woh saahibaan-e-taqwa mahfooz maqaam par honge
Baaghaat aur chashmon ke darmiyaan
Woh resham ki baareek aur moti poshaak pehne hue ek doosre ke saamne baithe honge
Aisa hi hoga, aur hum badi badi aankhon waali hooron se un ke jode laga denge
Woh wahaan har qism ke meve sukoon ke saath talab karenge
Aur wahaan pehli maut ke ilaawa kisi maut ka maza nahin chakhna hoga, aur Khuda inhein Jahannam ke azaab se mahfooz rakhega
Yeh sab aap ke Parwardigar ka fazl o karam hai, aur yahi insaan ke liye sab se badi kaamyaabi hai
Pas hum ne is Quran ko aap ki zabaan se aasaan kar diya hai ke shaayad yeh log naseehat haasil kar lein
Phir aap intezaar karein, aur yeh log bhi intezaar kar hi rahe hain
